1_crosscheck_model_evaluator.label: NUM
1_crosscheck_model_evaluator.explanation: explicit_basis_v22.evaluate works on multigraphs (index order inside antisymmetric tensors is re-assigned canonically) and sums eps contractions over SORTED blocks; its hodge5 is minus the repo hodge_star, so its D samples lie in the repo's +i space (reflected by e9 -> -e9 here; every D-containing invariant is a pure delta contraction, hence O(10)-invariant). With the model evaluator's own canonical index order and the 1/prod(k!) eps normalisation, chart531 reproduces every value; the declared formulas (machine_spec, used by chart531) differ from the invariants.json reference values by the listed factors.
